original_title: Enola Holmes 3 Review: Netflix’s Mystery Franchise Doesn’t Quite Find Its Way in the Mediterranean
summary_en: The Netflix mystery franchise returns for its third installment, taking Enola Holmes to the sun-drenched shores of Malta. While Millie Bobby Brown shines, the film struggles to recapture the magic of its predecessors.
ai_analysis: This installment offers a visually appealing backdrop but falls short on narrative depth, potentially alienating dedicated fans who crave more intricate mysteries and less focus on romantic subplots.

en.title: Enola Holmes 3: Malta Mystery Misses Mark Despite Millie Bobby Brown's Charm
en.summary: The Netflix mystery franchise returns for its third installment, taking Enola Holmes to the sun-drenched shores of Malta. While Millie Bobby Brown shines, the film struggles to recapture the magic of its predecessors.
en.body:
The **Enola Holmes** franchise has officially joined the exclusive Netflix trilogy club, a testament to its strong performance and critical reception. The first two films, starring **Millie Bobby Brown**, garnered significant viewership, cementing their place as a go-to for fans of clever mysteries and compelling characters. However, the latest entry, **Enola Holmes 3**, finds itself adrift in the Mediterranean, delivering a visually rich experience that, unfortunately, doesn't quite solve its own narrative puzzles.

The film whisks Enola away from the familiar London fog to the picturesque island of Malta. This exotic locale provides a stunning backdrop for the unfolding mystery, a welcome change of scenery that allows for a more lavish aesthetic. **Millie Bobby Brown** once again anchors the film with her signature charisma, effortlessly embodying the spirited and independent Enola. Yet, despite her captivating performance, the story itself feels less focused, diluted by a plot that, according to early reviews, leans more heavily on personal entanglements than on the intricate detective work that defined the series' early success.

## A Mediterranean Mystery Unraveled

Director **Philip Barantini**, known for his Emmy-winning work, takes the helm for this installment. While the visual direction is commendable, showcasing Malta's beauty, the narrative momentum seems to falter. Concerns raised prior to the film's release regarding the reduced screen time for key supporting characters like **Henry Cavill** (Sherlock Holmes) and **Helena Bonham Carter** (Eudoria Holmes) appear to be valid. Their diminished presence leaves a noticeable void, as their interactions with Enola were a significant draw for many viewers. The plot synopsis suggests a central conflict involving Sherlock's kidnapping, a potentially dramatic turn, but one that might detract from Enola's own sleuthing prowess. Furthermore, the increased emphasis on Enola's romantic life, particularly her impending nuptials to Lord Tewkesbury, risks overshadowing the core mystery-solving element that fans have come to expect.

## Fan Reception and Franchise Future

For the dedicated fanbase that propelled the **Enola Holmes** films to Netflix stardom, the shift in focus is a point of contention. While the franchise's success is undeniable, with millions tuning in for each installment, the move towards a more romance-centric plot and the reduced roles for fan-favorite characters raise questions about the series' future direction. The initial films were praised for balancing Enola's coming-of-age journey with engaging mysteries, a formula that resonated deeply. This latest outing, however, seems to be trading some of that intricate plotting for broader, more conventional romantic drama. The question remains whether this evolution will satisfy long-time viewers or alienate them in favor of a new audience.

## What's Next

As **Enola Holmes 3** makes its debut on Netflix, audiences will be keen to see how this deviation from the established formula plays out. Details regarding potential future installments beyond this trilogy have not yet been announced, leaving the franchise's long-term trajectory uncertain.

tr.title: Enola Holmes 3: Malta Gizemi İşe Yaramıyor
tr.summary: Netflix'in mystery franşizinin üçüncü filmi Enola Holmes'u Malta'nın güneş altında kalmış kıyılarına götürüyor. Millie Bobby Brown'un performansı parlasa da film, önceki filmlerinin büyüsünü yakalayamıyor. Enola Holmes serisi, güçlü performansıyla ve eleştirel beğeniyle Netflix'in trilogy kulübüne resmi olarak katıldı.
tr.body:
Enola Holmes franşizi, **Millie Bobby Brown**'un başrolde olduğu ilk iki filmiyle önemli bir izleyici kitlesi ve eleştirel beğeni elde etti. Ancak son film, **Enola Holmes 3**, kendini Akdeniz'de kaybolmuş buluyor ve görsel olarak zengin bir deneyim sunuyor, ancak kendi anlatı bulmacalarını çözme konusunda başarısız oluyor. 

 Film, Enola'yı Londra'nın tanıdık sisinden Malta'nın resimli adasına götürüyor. Bu egzotik mekan, gelişen gizemin güzel bir arka planı sunuyor, daha lüks bir estetik için hoş bir değişim sunuyor. **Millie Bobby Brown** yine filmi kendi karizmasıyla taşıyor, ruhlu ve bağımsız Enola'yı kolayca canlandırıyor. Ancak, onun büyüleyici performansı rağmen, hikaye daha az odaklanmış gibi görünüyor, kişisel ilişkiler üzerine daha çok odaklanan bir senaryo tarafından sulandırılmış hissediliyor. 

 ## Akdeniz Gizemi Çözülüyor 

 Yönetmen **Philip Barantini**, Emmy ödüllü çalışmasıyla bu bölümde görev alıyor. Görsel yönün takdir edilmesi gereken bir yönü var, Malta'nın güzelliğini gösteriyor, ancak anlatının momentumu gibi görünüyor. **Henry Cavill** (Sherlock Holmes) ve **Helena Bonham Carter** (Eudoria Holmes) gibi önemli destekleyici karakterlerin ekran süresinin azaltılmasıyla ilgili önceden yapılan endişeler geçerli görünüyor. Azalan varlıkları önemli bir boşluk bırakıyor, çünkü Enola ile olan etkileşimleri birçok izleyici için önemli bir çekim noktasıydı. 

 ## Hayran Alıntıları ve Franşiz Geleceği 

 **Enola Holmes** filmlerini Netflix yıldızlığına taşıyan bağlı hayran kitlesi için odakta yaşanan değişim, bir tartışma konusu. Franşizin başarısı inkar edilemez, milyonlarca kişinin her bölüm için izleyici kitlesine ulaştı, ancak romantik bir komploya ve fanatik karakterlerin azaltılmış rollerine doğru kayma, serinin gelecekteki yönü hakkında soruları gündeme getiriyor. İlk filmler, Enola'nın kendi büyüme yolculuğunu çekici gizemlerle dengelemesiyle övgü aldı, bu formül derin bir şekilde yankı uyandırdı. Ancak bu son bölüm, bazı karmaşık planları daha geniş, daha geleneksel romantik dramayla değiştiriyor gibi görünüyor. 

 ## Sonraki Aşamalar 

 **Enola Holmes 3**, Netflix'te debutunu yaparken, izleyiciler bu değişikliğin nasıl oynayacağını merakla bekleyecekler. Gelecek potansiyel bölümlerle ilgili detaylar henüz açıklanmadı, franşizin uzun vadeli rotasını belirsiz bırakıyor.

content_raw: Welcome to the Netflix Original Trilogy Club, Enola Holmes ! It’s no mystery why the Millie Bobby Brown-led franchise has joined the ranks of only a few Netflix Originals to hit a third movie: According to the two Netflix engagement reports , the original Enola Holmes was watched by the equivalent of 13.9 million people throughout 2023, and the sequel by 21 million; plus, they were two critically well-received films, as both scored positively on Metacritic and were certified “fresh” on Rotten Tomatoes. As opposed to films like Damsel and The Electric State , the Enola Holmes films seem like the path forward for Millie Bobby Brown as a young burgeoning movie star in her post- Stranger Things career. For myself, I will also add that I thought the second film was an improvement on the first, shedding the constraints of a young girl coming of age in late 19th-century British society, losing concerns about romance or her mother’s whereabouts, and moving forward with a well-tuned mystery solved alongside the greatest family ever to do it—with added screen time for Henry Cavill as Sherlock and Helena Bonham Carter as the mother, Eudoria. The tone improved drastically with a more heartfelt, dynamic, and adventurous spirit, and, as it was also the second film from director Harry Bradbeer, the sequel seemed to be more in sync with the strengths of its protagonist and more comfortable with increasing the pace, moving the camera, and tightening the edit. So, when I read the initial plot descriptions and production changes for Enola Holmes 3 , I did have some minor concerns: no Harry Bradbeer behind the camera, Sherlock being kidnapped as a major plot point, and a possible increase in romance over crime-solving with Enola’s nuptials to Lord Tewkesbury also in prime focus. The story also moves from the standard surroundings of a Holmes mystery in London to the Mediterranean island nation of Malta, which brings a far brighter seaside locale flavor to the more dark and mysterious cobblestone chaos that you may be accustomed to. But, of course, what this franchise—including this new film—has always had is the stability of the unchanging and talented main cast (Brown, Cavill, and Bonham Carter), a successful book series to shore up the plot, and a well-defined protagonist character whose evolution as a woman and influence on her family keeps us coming back film after film. Will the chemistry and established success be enough to anchor this third installment, or will it drift off course and put the franchise’s future prospects in jeopardy? ‘Tis I who says… It’s a little bit of both, I’m afraid.
